```sql
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  SUM(pts) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS points_per_game,
  SUM(reb) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS rebounds_per_game,
  SUM(ast) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS assists_per_game
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE played = 1
  AND game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
  AND (LOWER(player_name) = LOWER('LeBron James') OR LOWER(player_name) = LOWER('Stephen Curry'))
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY points_per_game DESC;
```
